nodes.label: MONA Hukuk Brand Identity
nodes.rationale: Brand system: navy (#1e2d4a-range) background, gold/amber (#b5622a-range) foreground, serif monogram initials, horizontal rule divider, small-caps tagline. Used consistently across favicon, apple-icon, and site theme (globals.css @theme tokens: cream, navy, gold, ink).

nodes.label: MONA Hukuk Apple Touch Icon — MH Attorney at Law Logo
nodes.norm_label: mona hukuk apple touch icon — mh attorney at law logo
nodes.rationale: Apple touch icon (180x180 equivalent) used as the PWA/browser icon for monahukuk.com. Displays the firm monogram 'MH' in gold/amber on a deep navy background with 'ATTORNEY AT LAW' tagline beneath a horizontal rule — matching the site's navy+gold brand palette. Serif typeface consistent with Cormorant Garamond brand identity.

links.rationale: The apple-icon.jpg directly materialises the MONA Hukuk brand identity as a touch icon asset.
